name: Gwendydd

attributes.attribute: She may have been Merlin's twin and lover.
Merlin gave her his magical powers and knowledge.
She married king Rhydderch Hael after Merlin went mad.

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gwendydd was a Welsh heroine and sister of the magician Merlin. She may have been his twin, his lover, or both. Once Viviane trapped him in her magical forest, Merlin passed his magical powers and knowledge on to her. In tales that call her his wife, Gwendydd married king Rhydderch Hael after Merlin went mad.

okr.objective: Portray Gwendydd as the sister and magical heir of Merlin.
